reasons: The written name is the bare nisba الزهري, which matches the nisba in C1's recorded names (ابن شهاب الزهري محمد بن مسلم), so the name is consistent with C1.

The chain places this narrator between سفيان (student) and عطاء بن يزيد (teacher), but the packet records no teachers, students or rijal passage for C1, so this teacher-student context cannot be checked against anything in the packet.
The neighbours have no recorded dates, so C1's recorded death year (124) can be neither confirmed nor ruled out as fitting the chain.
A bare nisba could belong to more than one narrator (mushtarak). Only one candidate is proposed, and that alone does not show that the name refers to C1.
Nothing in the packet points to a different person, so there are no grounds for contradicts either.

evidence.quote: عن سفيان، عن الزهري، عن عطاء بن يزيد

verdicts.uncertainty_note: This would become supports if the packet included a rijal passage for C1 naming عطاء بن يزيد as a teacher or سفيان as a student, or dates for the neighbouring narrators that fit a death year of 124. Outside knowledge not relied on: in common chain usage, a bare al-Zuhri who has Sufyan (ibn ʿUyayna) as his student and ʿAtaʾ ibn Yazid (al-Laythi) as his teacher is usually Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri. That strongly suggests C1, but the packet does not show it.

proposals.text: Add a rijal passage for C1 that lists his teachers and students, or the death years of سفيان and عطاء بن يزيد, so the chain context can be checked from the packet.
